verdict.rationale: Wise documents balance statement retrieval in many open and standard formats (JSON, CSV, XLSX, CAMT.053, MT940, QIF), and card transaction data is also retrievable via API, so financial transaction history is exportable. Nothing shows a complete account-wide data export or a documented account-closure path. Missing for 10: full account data export (recipients, cards, documents, profile data), documented offboarding/account-closure process, independent or hands-on corroboration of exports.
